Raft Race

Your rafts are personal. Your distance helps the whole team. Reach milestones together and choose the rewards you actually need.

Personal rafts, shared distance

Four teammates contribute to one distance total. Each player spends their own rafts. Everyone can claim a milestone once the team reaches its distance.

Some milestones give a choice box. Pick one option; a box does not grant every listed item.

Coordinate progress and reward choices

  1. Tell teammates when you expect to use your rafts, so they can plan around the team’s total distance.
  2. Check the next reward before chasing an arbitrary distance target.
  3. Choose box contents for your own needs—Pinballs, capsules, and other choices have different uses.

Compare your raft budget

Paid-spin mean distance is 5.82m before free spins. If free spins use the same independent distribution and can chain, the expected total becomes about 6.47m per paid raft. This is a model average, not a guaranteed return.

Choose a multiplier for control

A multiplier scales both cost and distance. Under the same wheel distribution, changing it does not change expected distance per raft; it changes the number of paid attempts and the size of each result.

“50× went farther for me” is an observation, not proof of better odds. Smaller multipliers offer more opportunities to stop near a target. Larger multipliers make progress in fewer, larger steps.
